verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair axis for a payroll/HR SaaS, but the evidence shows no user-definable rule or trigger-action capability in RUN. RUN & DONE is a recurring-payroll schedule rather than an event rule, AI error flagging is a built-in check rather than a user-defined rule, and API Central is a developer building block for constructing integrations, so none of these earn credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
